# Nibble

> Nibble is a free, account-free pixel art and animation editor that runs
> entirely in the browser, built to be used by AI agents. No backend: drawings
> stay in the browser's IndexedDB. The user's own browser agent draws through a
> JavaScript API at `window.nibble` on the editor page.

Nibble does not sell AI generation; it invites the user's own agent (for
example Claude in Chrome). Open https://nibble.nardin.app/editor/ and call
`window.nibble.help()` first: that call is the handshake, the UI switches to
Co-op Mode and the user sees a live ticker of every call. `help(topic)` covers
drawing, animation, rig, palette, export, project and permissions.

Golden rules for agents:

1. Draw a whole sprite with one `drawFromText({ rows, legend, x, y })` call,
   never pixel by pixel.
2. Wrap multi-step work in `beginBatch("label")` / `endBatch()`: one Ctrl+Z
   undoes all of it.
3. Call `readCanvas()` to check your work; it returns the format you write.
4. Read the `hint` field on every return value.
5. A denied call (`{ ok: false, deniedScope }`) is an answer: ask the user to
   allow the scope, do not work around it. `destructive` and `files` are off by
   default.
6. To animate, name parts once (`definePart`) and move them by name
   (`movePart`, `tween`).

## Docs

- [Full agent reference (plain text)](https://nibble.nardin.app/llms-full.txt): every call, permissions, limits, rig, export formats, typical flow
- [Agent API page](https://nibble.nardin.app/agent/): the same reference for humans, with copyable examples
- [Editor](https://nibble.nardin.app/editor/): where `window.nibble` lives

## About

- [Home](https://nibble.nardin.app/): what Nibble is; free, no account, no server
- [Privacy policy](https://nibble.nardin.app/privacy/): drawings never leave the browser; cookieless Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits (English translation; the [Turkish original](https://nibble.nardin.app/gizlilik/) prevails)
- [KVKK notice](https://nibble.nardin.app/kvkk/en/): Turkish data protection notice in English (the [Turkish original](https://nibble.nardin.app/kvkk/) prevails)
- [Nardin](https://nardin.app): the independent developer (Emre Kızak) behind Nibble

## Optional

- Exports: PNG, animated GIF, lossless APNG, sprite sheet with Aseprite-compatible JSON (Godot, Unity), `.nibble` project file
- Valid fps: 5, 10, 12.5, 20, 25, 50 (GIF stores delay in centiseconds)
- Limits: 120 calls per 10 s, canvas up to 512 x 512, 250 000 pixels per `setPixels` call
